title: Mechatronics
full_title: Mechatronics: Sensors, Actuators and Embedded Control
tagline: Sensors, signal conditioning and data acquisition, microcontrollers, electric motors and drives, hydraulic and pneumatic actuators, and motion control
summary: Mechatronics combines mechanisms, electronics and software into machines that sense and act. The course covers sensors, signal conditioning and data acquisition, microcontrollers and real-time software, DC, stepper and brushless motors and their drives, hydraulic and pneumatic actuation, and closed-loop motion control, ending with the design of complete mechatronic systems.

chapters.title: Mechatronic systems
chapters.summary: The elements of a mechatronic system, and the circuit basics needed to build one.

chapters.title: Sensors
chapters.summary: Measuring position, speed, acceleration, force, strain, pressure and temperature, and the specifications of sensors.

chapters.title: Signal conditioning and data acquisition
chapters.summary: Operational-amplifier circuits, bridges and filters, noise, analogue-to-digital conversion, sampling and aliasing.

chapters.title: Microcontrollers and embedded software
chapters.summary: Microcontroller architecture, digital input and output, timers, interrupts, pulse-width modulation and real-time programming.

chapters.title: Electric motors and drives
chapters.summary: DC, stepper and brushless motors, their models and torque–speed curves, and H-bridges and motor drives.

chapters.title: Hydraulic and pneumatic actuators
chapters.summary: Pumps, valves, cylinders and motors in fluid-power circuits, and their dynamics.

chapters.title: Motion control
chapters.summary: Closed-loop position and speed control of motor-driven axes, encoders, feedforward and trajectory following.

chapters.title: Designing mechatronic systems
chapters.summary: Integrating sensors, actuators and controllers, safety interlocks, and case studies from printers to vehicles.
